description: The chart represents the distribution of entity topics, comparing the proportions of different categories. The pie chart is divided into five slices, representing the topics "Moive", "Common", "Person", "Book", and "Sport". The largest slice, "Moive", is colored light blue and accounts for approximately 41.2% of the total, while the second-largest slice, "Person", is colored pink and represents around 30.5%. The "Common" slice is green and makes up about 14.9%, followed by "Book", which is yellow and accounts for 9.1%. The smallest slice, "Sport", is purple and represents 4.3%. The chart includes a legend that matches the colors to their respective topics, and percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered in descending size, with the largest slice first.
